items.title: Father Al Lewis Interview, 1972-02-21
items.q: It was Henry Harden's band. And Buddy Charles, Henry Harden, and one of his brothers there... William Casimir was playing with him.

ctx.x: I mean she was killed, she died from it up here. Now that's Uncle Jim's nephew, but I didn't know too much about him, got the beacon rest from his back. Yeah, Vic. But I knew his daddy, his name, his daddy called Buddy, you understand? I knew his uncle, the elder ones, you understand? Yeah, I knew Buddy and Nick.
I knew Nick and Buddy. Yeah.
